versions.content: Type for a role parameter I Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00029 The type for a role parameter shall be the ImplementationDataType of the RunnableEntityArgument if • the RunnableEntityArgument references an ImplementationDataType AND • the ImplementationDataType of the RunnableEntityArgument does not resolve to an Array Implementation Data Type AND • the serverArgumentImplPolicy of the RunnableEntityArgument is not defined AND • no mapping to a BswModuleEntry is defined for the RunnableEntity .
